caption: Mont Blanc massif, Courmayeur
composition: Alpine massif above valley town lights · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the valley from a high vantage point toward the Mont Blanc massif at first light. Snow-covered peaks fill the upper frame, the central summit catching the first pink alpenglow, while dark forested ridges slope down on both sides. Far below, the scattered warm lights of the valley town still glow in the blue shadow of the modelled 23 September 2026, 06:40 dawn.
